en: Now we're almost done with this long

There are still minor improvements we could
make and you should consider.
And that would, for example, be that in
showErrorMessage,
we sometimes call it with just a message
and sometimes, of course, we call it with a
message and an item, which is why we accept
both message and item.
Now this is
okay, we have this if check here,
but we can actually get rid of this
pointless if check here
if we simply always console.log the item
but make sure that the item is never
undefined,
but instead maybe give it a default value of
an empty object or map.
And default parameter values of course are
also accepted and supported in many
programming languages.
So now we ensure that there always is an
item,
even if it's just an empty map, which we
then therefore output here.
So that's a tiny improvement we can make
here
to get rid of one extra if check. Because as
you saw throughout this section,
getting rid of if checks can really help
with readability.
